Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on owners. I’m Neha from Redwood Legal — nice to meet you. A couple practical notes from our side to keep the redline exchange efficient:

- Preferred format: please send contract redlines as a tracked Word document or a marked PDF; we’ll respond with a tracked Word counter.
- Typical turnaround: we aim for a 7–10 business day initial review on straightforward SOW + MSA redlines. If the counterparty proposes material changes to indemnity or data-handling we’ll escalate to our legal director (CC Laura) which can add time.
- Please include any required security or data residency clauses up front so we can coordinate with engineering.

I’ve attached a short guidance doc (Redlines-Elix-20261103.docx) that explains our typical redline positions and what we can often accept without escalation. That should help Danielle prioritize.

Proposed timeline adjustment (based on procurement freeze week): if Elix can target redlines to us by COB 2026-11-18 instead of 11/20 we’ll be more comfortable hitting the 11/30 DocuSign target. Let us know if that’s feasible.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
